reused_proven_pattern: CHR transaction post-apply verification uses an independent fresh session and does not reuse apply observation as verification state.
contract: Vendor adapters acquire and normalize a fresh managed-state projection.
Apply observation cannot be reused as verification state.
The existing StateEngine computes deterministic desired-vs-readback drift.
Exact managed-state match is PASS; any missing, extra or changed managed value is MISMATCH.
Verification output carries desired/readback digests and deterministic drift evidence.
The verifier exposes no transport, apply capability, production writer or write authorization.
